**Year with the largest percent‑decrease in secondary‑school students**

| Report year | Secondary‑school enrollment (end‑of‑year count) | Percent change vs. previous year |
|-------------|----------------------------------------------|---------------------------------|
| 2016 | 73,972 students | – |
| 2017 | 73,570 students | \(\frac{73,570-73,972}{73,972}\times100 = -0.54\%\) |
| 2018 | 72,994 students | \(\frac{72,994-73,570}{73,570}\times100 = -0.78\%\) |

**Largest percent decrease:** **2018** (≈ –0.78 %).  
The decline from 2017 to 2018 is larger than the decline from 2016 to 2017.

| Year | Source & Page | Data excerpt |

Based on the enrollment figures reported in the Toronto District School Board’s Director’s Annual Reports, 2018 shows the largest percent decrease in the number of secondary‑school students (‑0.78 %), followed by 2017 (‑0.54 %).
